backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features with their IDs, titles, affected files, components, and test IDs — primarily covering translation key fixes for ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each file's purpose and notable recent changes across the TrueOrigin Exports app.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including color tokens for background, foreground, primary, border, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React app, setting the page title to 'True Origin Company LLP' and mounting the app at the `#root` div via `src/main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app shell that sets up TanStack Router with page routes, a responsive NavBar with scroll-based styling, mobile hamburger menu, language selector, and renders all major page sections and standalone pages.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component that uses the `useLanguage` hook to render translated headings, body text, checklist items, operations list, and vision/mission cards.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with a translated info panel (address, phone, dual email links) and an enquiry form with submission state handling, all text sourced via the `useLanguage` translation hook.
frontend/src/components/ExportCargoSecti: Renders a landing page section about export cargo, displaying a hero image and three highlight cards (documentation, packaging, global reach) with i18n support.
frontend/src/components/ExportCertificat: Full-page component showing export certifications, quality control steps, and product-specific packaging/documentation details, with a back-to-home link and i18n support.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand logo, contact details, quick navigation links that scroll to page sections (with cross-route support), and legal/policy links.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, headline, subheadline, CTA buttons linking to export certification and the contact section, and a scroll-down indicator.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown component for switching between English, Hindi, and Marathi using the LanguageContext, with styling that adapts based on navbar scroll state.
frontend/src/components/PrivacyPolicyPag: Standalone privacy policy page that renders numbered sections from i18n keys, a header with a back link, and a contact callout at the bottom.
Products section displaying a grid of four product cards (moringa, curry leaves, vegetables, custom sourcing) with images and icons, plus a farm image gallery, all i18n-driven.
frontend/src/components/QualityComplianc: Renders a 'Quality & Compliance' section displaying a grid of six documentation items and a CTA link to the export-certification page, with text sourced from the language context.
frontend/src/components/SocialMediaSecti: Renders a social media section with three placeholder video cards (coming soon) and Instagram/YouTube icon links, using translated text from the language context.
frontend/src/components/TermsAndConditio: Displays a full Terms and Conditions page with eight translated sections, a back-to-home link, and a contact email callout at the bottom.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for multi-language support (English, Hindi, Marathi) with a translation lookup function that falls back to English or the raw key.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Playfair Display and Poppins fonts, defines CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, and sets up Tailwind base/component/utility layers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/translations/translations.t: Exports a nested translations object containing string key-value pairs for English, Hindi, and Marathi, covering all UI text used across the application.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom design system with forest/gold/cream color palettes, Playfair Display and Poppins font families, custom shadows, border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for animate, typography, and container queries.
project_state.json: Persistent project state file (version 49) tracking the TrueOrigin Exports website's summary, architectural notes, known rendering/UI bugs, and a list of implemented features for build planning and continuity.
